risks.risk: Not all pallets may be genuine EPAL-certified; some could be unmarked or counterfeit stamps mixed in

risks.risk: Structural condition (cracks, missing boards, broken blocks, protruding nails) not visible on all units

risks.if_unproven: price as for general wear/unverified condition, assume some defects

risks.proof: Photo of ISPM 15 stamp (HT or MB mark) alongside EPAL mark
risks.if_unproven: price as non-certified/untreated for export-grade use

risks.risk: Total quantity and uniform sizing not confirmed

risks.risk: Age and prior usage history unknown, affecting remaining lifespan
risks.proof: Video showing pallets from multiple angles including underside wear
risks.if_unproven: price as used/aged stock, not new-condition

proof_requests: Close-up photos of stamps and tags on every pallet in the lot
Underside and edge shots showing board/nail condition
Photo of ISPM 15 heat-treatment mark if present
Wide shot with tape measure showing total count and dimensions
Any purchase/certification documentation for the EPAL pallets
